entries.rationale: Behaviors 22b-22f give exact token semantics, error code and message; two files in one module; extends an existing renderPack with prescribed guard-after-expansion ordering.

Fence format, neutralization predicate and warning code are fully pinned by 22g/22h plus review note SEC-1; node:crypto has precedent elsewhere in lib/, but no fencing pattern exists yet in this codebase.

Marker strings are exact, but UTF-8 boundary-safe truncation, cumulative accounting and budget inheritance through resolveExtends have no codebase precedent and compose three mechanisms; checkpoint after RED.
Single branch split on an existing denylist check with both codes and messages specified; mechanical application against an established call site.
Full YAML is given verbatim in both spec and plan; declarative template edits, but spans two template trees plus spec frontmatter and has a stated latent blast radius on five validate checks.

Touches the shared specBlock site feeding all three dispatch stages plus renderArgs and the tier-2 eval suite with a golden master; nonce reuse and no-leak-into-description constraints need a human look at the RED tests.

Prompt and SKILL.md prose edits are well specified, but the new 22q mapping test invents a title-to-bullet matching heuristic, and SKILL.md edits must satisfy inline-Node and skill-extension policy tests.
